nodes.description: Public address state variable storing the contract owner, set once in the constructor.
Public uint state variable tracking the last completed migration index.
Constructor that assigns the deployer address (msg.sender) to the owner state variable.
Public function guarded by the restricted modifier that writes the completed migration value into state.
Modifier acting as an access-control gate: it executes the body only when msg.sender equals owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment and for the restricted access-control comparison.
External uint parameter supplied to setCompleted and forwarded to the last_completed_migration state variable.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside the constructor and flows into the owner assignment.
Constructor writes the deployer address into the owner state variable.
The restricted modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender against owner to decide whether to execute the guarded function body.
The restricted modifier gates entry into setCompleted based on the caller identity check.
The completed parameter is passed as the argument into the setCompleted function.
The completed parameter value is written directly into the last_completed_migration state variable.
setCompleted performs the state write to last_completed_migration.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter is only used as the input of setCompleted before being stored, so it can be normalized into the setCompleted function node.
